Back for more?|[[Isaak]] on Wave 10 ([[Competition Court]])|audio = AdidasMission2Wave10-1.ogg}} }} ==Description== The '''Referee''' was an enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]] and the final boss of [[Backyard Beginnings]]. It had high but slow speed. It had one ability where it will attack a tower in a range of 20, applying a 6 second 15% [[Scared Debuff]] and 30% [[Firerate Debuff]] to any tower hit in a range of 6 and an angle of 60. ==Appearance== The '''Referee''' has tan skin. It is wearing a light yellow T-shirt with a chest pocket with a black adidas logo on it. Its T-shirt also has a black collar. It also has a whistle with its strings wrapped around its neck. The '''Referee''' also wears a black belt with a white buckle that maintains its black shorts. It also has long white socks and black sports shoes with white shoe ties and the entire front being white. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. *You can space out towers to make less of your towers get hit by its attack, but this is not necessary. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} RefereeCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} BackyardLegendsPI.png|'''Referee''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} BackyardLegendsIcon.png|'''Refere''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} AdidasMission1EasyRender.png|'''Referee''' on the matchmaking icon. AdidasMission1HardRender.png|'''Referee''' on the matchmaking icon. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} RefereeIconIG.png|'''Referee''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Referee''' is likely based on [[wp:Pierluigi Collina|Pierluigi Collina]], an Italian former football referee whose career started from on 1977 to 2005 before his active refereeing came to an end. **He was named ''"The World's Best Referee"'' by the [[wp:International Federation of Football History & Statistics|International Federation of Football History]]. *Despite there being no freezing towers in the event, the '''Referee''' has [[Freeze Immunity]]. *The [[Null Pyromancer]] was used as the base for the '''Referee''', as they share the same ability. *The '''Referee''' is near identical to the [[Null Pyromancer]], reusing its attacks and even its stats slight re-adjusted in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]]. *The '''Referee''' uses the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/311/Robloxian-2-0 Robloxian 2.0] bundle, and is the first enemy to use it. *The '''Referee''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Referee''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Referee's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Referee''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{BackyardBeginnings|[[Duffle Bag]]|Wave 8|Referee|Wave 10|End|N/A}} {{CompetitionCourt|[[Duffle Bag]]|Wave 9|Referee|Wave 10 (Easy)|hardt2 = Referee & [[Soccer Speedy]]|hardw2 = Wave 10 (Hard)|[[Crowd Pleaser]]|Wave 11}} {{VictoryField|[[Duffle Bag]]|Wave 9|Referee|Wave 10|[[Crowd Pleaser]]|Wave 11}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
